cohort: 1725 infants admitted to either one of the two neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) of Cairo University Hospital in Egypt between January and December 2014.
finding: Mortality was significantly higher among inborns (37.2%) than outborns (17.2%).
gest_age: Majority of inborns were preterm (72.5%) compared to a majority of full-term outborns (67.7%).
birth_weight: Birth weight was collected, but specific values are not reported in the abstract.
